stories.title: WNBA Finals Game 3 live updates, analysis and highlights
stories.summary: The Finals resume with Game 3 as Atlanta hosts Golden State. ESPN is courtside with analysis.

stories.title: Ohtani won't require surgery; Dodgers 'fully expect him to pitch next year'
stories.summary: Shohei Ohtani will not require surgery to treat any ailment he dealt with this past season, Dodgers president of baseball operations Andrew Friedman said Wednesday. And: "I fully expect him to pitch next year," Friedman added.

stories.title: Hall of Fame hoops coach Huggins has progressive cognitive condition
stories.summary: Hall of Fame college basketball coach Bob Huggins has a progressive cognitive condition that is affecting his memory and aspects of his daily life, his family said.

stories.title: Goodell: NFL welcomes investigation into Eagles QB Hurts' medical care
stories.summary: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said Wednesday that the league welcomes an investigation into the Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots.

stories.title: Dream arrange suite for Kanter Freedom at Finals to address his safety concerns
stories.summary: The Atlanta Dream and State Farm Arena arranged for former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom to have a private suite for his protection at Wednesday night's Game 3 of the WNBA Final against the Golden State Valkyries.
